d: A fluffy, canine-like creature with a stout build, featuring thick, layered fur in a mix of snowy white and deep slate blue. The head is topped with long, shaggy, deep slate blue hair that falls over the face in thick strands, while the ears are tipped with soft pink inner linings. A single, sharp, glowing crimson eye is visible peering through the fur. BODY COLOR: snowy white and deep slate blue
